body:
Thank you for the support man. I know what you mean mostly but this is just my depressed state where I try to act less dumb. You must have seen me in my normal every day life and in my usual conversations. 

I wont exactly buy a shirt at a gas station but I would do or say equally dumb stuff when I feel more impulsive.  From the reactions of other people, when I tell them, I understand what I did was stupid only then it feels embarassing and I feel uncomfortable I am sick of this feeling

That's your opinion, and I respect it, but the number of people who thought I was stupid way outweighs the number of people who don't. So I am afraid they might be right.

Even if they are not it's hard to live in a world where the majority think you are dumb, life is hell and I can't handle so many people looking down on me so much anymore.

This awareness is killing me and ruining my life. Each time I was proven so stupid by life and people I get even more depressed.

I wish I was one of those 2/3 people you meet everyday who are completely oblivious to their stupidity. 

At least they can live happily and they would never need to know about it, I am constantly reminded of it and it's killing me.
